title: St. Vincent–St. Mary vs. VASJ — Football (2025–2026)
summary: The Vikings take the September 2025 matchup; Rylan Hurley is noted for his work on both sides for the Irish.
article_headline: VASJ Takes 37–7 Road Win Against St. Vincent–St. Mary
article_dek: The Vikings take the September 2025 matchup; Rylan Hurley is noted for his work on both sides for the Irish.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — Villa Angela–St. Joseph defeated St. Vincent–St. Mary 37–7 on September 19, 2025. The Vikings put 37 points on the board while limiting the Fighting Irish to a single touchdown.

Despite the loss, St. Vincent–St. Mary's athletics department later recognized Rylan Hurley's two-way performance against VASJ in its fall sports season review. Hurley's contributions were among the performances the program chose to highlight from the season.

The Summit County Sports gallery documents the matchup through Mason Bybee's sideline photographs. Specific touchdown descriptions have not been independently verified and are not attributed to individual players here.
article_highlights: Villa Angela–St. Joseph defeated St. Vincent–St. Mary 37–7 on September 19, 2025.
The Vikings' defense limited the Irish to one touchdown.
STVM singled out Rylan Hurley's work on offense and defense in its season review despite the loss.
article_source_label: STVM Athletics · fall sports season review (score also confirmed by Joe Eitel)
